northStar: One real workflow reaches a measurable outcome through an accountable operating record.

products.name: Shop
products.job: Run orders, available-stock counts, purchasing and receipt, fulfilment, payment status, bounded returns, exceptions, and daily close from one accountable shop record.
products.nextGate: Repeat one authenticated order-to-close and return-exception pilot on an isolated hosted tenant with a named operator, baseline, and five-day evidence plan.

products.name: Plant
products.job: Run jobs, accountable short closes, output, job-linked material use, quality, equipment observations, maintenance, and shift exceptions from one plant record.
products.nextGate: Validate one line, maintenance, or quality workflow with an operator, supervisor review, and measured shift evidence.

products.name: Website
products.job: Turn an approved business brief into a finite, reviewable website and one deterministic downloadable site file.
products.nextGate: Complete one named-business brief through accepted responsive preview and retained managed artifact before connecting domain or publish authority.

products.name: Ecommerce
products.job: Create a simple customer storefront from a read-only Shop catalogue, then add structured order intent without duplicating Shop back-office records.
products.nextGate: Rehearse authenticated, revisioned, catalogue-bound storefront setup and recoverable request retention on one owner-approved isolated non-production tenant before adding cart, payment, delivery execution, external messaging, or a normalized indexed queue.

sharedCapabilities.name: AI assistance
sharedCapabilities.job: Prepare bounded, reviewable work inside Shop, Plant, Website, and Ecommerce from approved records.
sharedCapabilities.nextGate: Pass the server-only golden-set evaluation for Order Intake with provenance, zero side effects, human review, and measured correction effort before exposing an interactive capability.

internalSystems.name: SuperMega HQ
internalSystems.job: Coordinate Product, Engineering, Growth, Finance, evidence, exceptions, and owner decisions for SuperMega itself.

internalSystems.name: R&D and resource intelligence
internalSystems.job: Discover, verify, test, compare, and convert useful resources into reusable implementation guidance.

researchGates.gate: Compare Vercel Workflows with the existing Cloud Tasks runtime using one approval-wait use case.
Adopt only after the existing fixture corpus, server-only structured output, provenance, budget, human review, and zero-side-effect checks pass.
Redact customer content and correlate request, workflow, model, tool, and database operations.
Adopt TanStack Table or virtualization only after measured row volume exceeds the native interface.
Add only when simultaneous operators create a measured refresh problem.
Reconsider only if the existing relational system of record and worker runtime cannot meet a documented requirement.

nonGoals: Commerce or Production as public product names
Fake autonomous employees or unreviewed external actions
Duplicate Shop and Ecommerce back offices
One page or domain per capability
